products.title: The Kinky Curly Half Wig
products.descriptionHtml:
A kinky curly half wig made with 100% Indian human hair, cuticle aligned, cut to sit behind your own leave-out so the hairline is genuinely yours. No glue, no lace, no adhesive of any kind. Combs and an adjustable strap hold it, and it goes on in about a minute.

Cuticle aligned means every strand runs in the same direction, so the hair stays soft and resists tangling. Co-wash it, define it, or stretch it with a blowout when you want a change.

Choosing your density

  • 180% reads as everyday natural. Lighter on the head, easier to blend, and the right choice if you want it to pass without a second look.
  • 250% is noticeably fuller, with more body at the ends. Choose it for a bigger silhouette, and for lengths past 20" where volume keeps the shape from thinning out.

Choosing your length

Lengths are measured straight, before the curl. A kinky curly texture will wear roughly three to four inches shorter than the number on the label. If you want it to fall at collarbone, size up.

18" at 250% is our most ordered combination.

In the box

  • Your half wig on a 22.5" cap with adjustable straps
  • Wide tooth comb
  • Silk scrunchie
  • HD wig cap
  • Care card, in branded packaging

Care

Co-wash in cool water and condition generously, working from the ends up. Air dry where you can. Keep heat low and occasional. Store it on a stand or in the box rather than folded.

Each unit is individually made, so small differences in curl pattern and parting are normal.

products.title: The Yaki Body Wave Half-Wig

Yaki body wave is the texture that blends most easily with relaxed and blown-out natural hair. The wave is soft and loose rather than tight, so the leave-out melts into it without much work. Choosing your density

  • 250% carries more body through the ends. Choose it past 20", or any time you want the wave to read fuller and more deliberate.

Choosing your length

Lengths are measured straight, before the wave. A body wave wears roughly one to two inches shorter than the label. 20" sits around mid-back on most people.

Care

Wash in cool water with a sulphate free shampoo, condition from the ends up, and air dry to keep the wave pattern. Heat is fine occasionally, but low and rarely is what makes it last. Store it on a stand or in the box rather than folded.

products.title: Indian Straight Bundles
products.descriptionHtml:
100% Indian human hair, cuticle aligned, straight, in its natural black, 100g per bundle. Take a single bundle to add length to a set you already own, or a set of three for a full install at a better price.

Cuticle aligned means every strand runs in the same direction, so the hair stays soft and resists tangling. It moves with a natural shine, takes heat with a protectant, and holds a curl when you set it.

1 bundle or 3?

Most full installs take three bundles. Two is enough for a partial or for shorter lengths, and four gives a very full look past 22". A set of three costs considerably less than three singles.

Choosing your length

Straight hair wears true to length: an 18" bundle falls at about 18". Mixed sets give you natural layering and movement. Matched lengths give you a fuller, blunter look. If you are unsure, 20" / 22" / 24" is the set most people reach for.

What you receive with a set of 3

  • Three 100g Indian straight bundles
  • Wide tooth comb
  • Silk scrunchie
  • Care card and branded packaging

Care

Wash in cool water, condition generously, and air dry or blow dry on low with a heat protectant. Detangle from the ends up with a wide tooth comb. Treated well, your hair lasts well beyond a single install.

products.title: Raw Vietnamese Wavy Bundles
products.descriptionHtml:
100% raw Vietnamese hair from a single donor. A soft wave in its natural colour, 100g per bundle. Take a single bundle to add length to a set you already own, or a set of three for a full install at a better price.

Raw means the hair is cut from one donor and never chemically processed. No acid wash, no silicone, no re-dyeing, so it moves, blends and ages the way your own hair does. Wear it wavy, define it with a curl cream, or blow it out straight. Double drawn, so the thickness holds from root to tip.

1 bundle or 3?

Most full installs take three bundles. Two is enough for a partial or for shorter lengths, and four gives a very full look past 24". A set of three costs considerably less than three singles.

Choosing your length

Lengths are measured with the hair pulled straight, so a wavy bundle falls about an inch shorter than the number on the label. Mixed sets give you natural layering and movement. Matched lengths give you a fuller, blunter look. If you are unsure, 20" / 22" / 24" is the set most people reach for.

What you receive with a set of 3

  • Three 100g raw wavy bundles
  • Wide tooth comb
  • Silk scrunchie
  • Care card and branded packaging

Care

Wash in cool water, condition generously, and air dry to keep the wave. Detangle from the ends up with a wide tooth comb. Use heat with a protectant. Treated well, raw hair lasts years rather than months.

Because this is real single-donor hair, ends can be slightly finer from 24" and up, as hair naturally sheds as it grows. The hair is never re-dyed, so a few strands may show soft golden or reddish tones from natural sun exposure. Both are marks of genuine raw hair.
